workItemReview.finding: Solver remains deterministic shadow/observe and parent routing remains off by broad default. Route decisions cannot silently substitute or switch the pinned parent model.
Phase shadow records only observations. Strict phase policy is enforced at the call carrier while one provider-visible schema stays stable across intake, execute, verify, review and repair.
Acceptance and performance assurance remain Task-Contract-derived advisory projections. Unsupported and unresolved languages abstain; no broad advisory path spends a model turn.

Helpers remain recommend-first and zero-turn by default. Automatic helper work is read-only and globally dispatch-bounded; explicit owned work retains one writer, finite ceilings, cancellation, privacy and parent-only merge.
Semantic repair and specialist review remain strict-high-risk opt-in, exact-path, one-continuation, mutation-bound and final-verifier-bound with finite handoff.

All 21 advanced-capability pairs across three profiles resolve only their pinned authority. Invalid semantic dependencies, aggregate dispatch overflow, duplicate continuation and non-independent rollback fail closed.
